==Description==
The '''Zombie Horse''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that appeared in the third night of the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]. It had an average amount of health and was fast.

==Appearance==
The '''Zombie Horse''' consisted of two entities, a zombified horse and a knight humanoid. The zombified horse had green skin and yellow glowing eyes. Some parts of its body were cut open and exposed. The knight had green skin and wore a grey helmet, chestplate, shoulder-pads and leggings. It had a pike on its back.

==Strategy==
*Towers with high DPS, such as the [[Minigunner]], [[Accelerator]] or [[Ranger]] are recommended against this.
**You can also use the [[Commander]] to boost your towers' firerate, abling them to kill it faster.
*You should use towers that slow down enemies, such as the [[Toxic Gunner]], [[Electroshocker]] or [[Sledger]] due to its fast speed.
**Due to its short range, the [[Sledger]] may be less effective at slowing down this enemy compared to the other towers.
